comment: Evidence v2 (P67.7 / T2.1; hardened remediation-v2 1.1, DC-1 approved 2026-08-02): fact-checker sources excluded from model-facing evidence packs. Fact-checker VERDICTS are gold-side only — never in model context (locked invariant S-1). v2 adds article-level exclusion: 'path_patterns' regexes match any URL path on ANY domain; 'verticals' are per-domain regexes for outlets whose fact-check sections don't live under one prefix; 'allowlist' entries always win (government program pages whose path happens to contain 'factcheck'). Measured 2026-08-02: v1 rules excluded 772 distinct stored URLs, v2 catches 120 more with one .gov false positive (allowlisted class). Snippet/title text matching was considered and REJECTED (DC-1): evidence has no title field and snippets are model prose.
